purpose: Anatomical/art research only; no runtime edits.

sources.title: TeachMeAnatomy — Bones of the Hand
sources.read: Full public article and bone diagram.
sources.use: Carpals/metacarpals/phalanges; two thumb phalanges vs three other digits.

sources.title: TeachMeAnatomy — Muscles of the Hand
sources.read: Full public article and thenar diagram.
sources.use: Thenar/hypothenar masses, opposition, intrinsic muscle function.

sources.title: TeachMeAnatomy — Metacarpophalangeal Joint
sources.use: MCP structure and movement; not a writing-angle prescription.

sources.title: TeachMeAnatomy — Proximal Interphalangeal Joint
sources.use: PIP hinge, not a free lateral ball joint.

sources.title: TeachMeAnatomy — Wrist Joint
sources.use: Wrist movement axes; distinguish from forearm pronation.

sources.title: Dounskaia, Van Gemmert, Stelmach (2000) — Interjoint coordination during handwriting-like movements
sources.read: Metadata and abstract via Europe PMC; no claim of full-text access.
sources.use: Nine right-handed subjects, controlled line/circle drawing with inkless pen; coordinated wrist/finger motion; not full telegram writing.

sources.title: Schwellnus et al. (2013) — Writing forces associated with four pencil grasp patterns in grade 4 children
sources.read: Public full text, methods/results and Figure 1 photo.
sources.use: 74 Grade4 children; different mature grasps; do not transfer population conclusions to Elias.

sources.title: Schwellnus et al. (2012) — Effect of pencil grasp on the speed and legibility of handwriting in children
sources.use: 120 Grade4 children; no significant mature-grasp effect on speed/legibility in that sample.
sources.authors_indexed: Schwellnus H, Carnahan H, Kushki A, Polatajko H, Missiuna C, Chau T.

sources.title: de Almeida, da Cruz, Magna, Ferrigno (2013) — An electromyographic analysis of two handwriting grasp patterns
sources.read: Abstract via Europe PMC; author metadata as indexed.
sources.use: 24 university students; different proximal muscle recruitment in static/dynamic tripod; not a universal health verdict.
sources.authors_indexed: de Almeida PH, da Cruz DM, Magna LA, Ferrigno IS.

sources.title: Chang, Chen, Yu (2015) — Biomechanical analyses of prolonged handwriting in subjects with and without perceived discomfort
sources.read: Abstract via Europe PMC; author metadata as indexed.
sources.use: 40 young adults,30min task; wrist position and soreness association, not a fixed ideal pose.
sources.authors_indexed: Chang SH, Chen CL, Yu NY.

sources.title: Lin et al. (2022) — Pen-grip kinetics in children with and without handwriting difficulties
sources.read: Open full-text XML obtained; abstract and introduction reviewed. Methods/results not independently analysed.
sources.use: 64 children; grip force, tip force and hand force are distinct; not adult quantitative target.

sources.title: Spencer authors — Theory of Spencerian Penmanship (1874)
sources.read: Metadata, OCR, scans printed pp9/10/11 (image leaves n10/n11/n12).
sources.use: Historical penholding and finger/forearm/combined/whole-arm movement; prescription of a school, not evidence every operator used it.

sources.title: A.N.Palmer — The Palmer Method of Business Writing (1915 edition)
sources.read: Metadata and OCR excerpts; no image validation in this research.
sources.use: Muscular movement tradition and paper repositioning; this edition postdates1894 and is not direct period proof.
